The SWITCH TEST screen displays the status of the switches. The display changes when any of the switches are operated. Press both Service button and Test button together to exit and return to the Menu.
The number increments each time a coin signal is received.
The display changes from OFF to ON each time the respective switch is operated.
The figure changes corresponding to the joystick angle when the joystick is tilted. The figure will change colour when the joystick is tilted to its maximum angle of defelection.
(7) is for the left/right direction, and (8) is for the forward/backward direction. A bar extends from the centre corresponding to the direction and deflection of the joystick.
The dispaly changes from OFF to ON when either of the Change buttons are pressed.
Displays the input force of the ball assembly used during the game.
The left OFF changes to ON, (ON/OFF), when the ball button is pressed gently and the right OFF changes to ON, (ON/ON), when the ball button is pressed hard.
Ared bar is displayed above the line when the ball button is pressed. The bar length indicates the kick speed.
